_about: What Product Owners, BSAs and Scrum Masters do, grouped by job. Argus shows each lens's groups as the 'What I do' list (every task opens a screen with buttons; Jira changes are previewed first) and hides the developer controls. The dashboard shows the same groups as read-only tabs: each task's panels, with a link back to the task in Argus. A task opens one of: pane (a Backlog screen: groom, groomprep, plan, calendar, followups, create), skill (a single-task Devin session), menu (approvals or sessions in the top bar). Panels not named by any task go under Reference.
